title: 第5章【冥婚】高人
slug: 诡异副本勇敢者的游戏
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“没错，这些坟墓变矮了。”

顾方环视了一圈，脸色铁青，“而且距离我们越近的坟墓变化的更加厉害。”

“看样子，是里面有什么东西要出来了。”

顾原的心已经提到了嗓子眼，他和顾方不一样，他是实打实的人，可是顾方不是，他只是一个剧本杀里的角色。

“没有退路了。”

话音刚落，就听身旁的顾方忽的大喊一声不好，不等顾原回头看，身旁的顾方猛地拉着顾原往前跑了几步。

这时，顾原才看到距离顾方最近的那个坟墓里竟然有一只铁青的手伸了出来，并且还抓到了顾方。

“你没事吧？”顾原低头一看，发现顾方的脚踝出已经出现鲜血，显然这是刚才那只手抓的。

“没事。”顾方摇摇头说道。

两人的脸色都异常难看，尤其是顾原，他根本想不到竟然会出现这么诡异恐怖的事情。

“看样子，今天想抢回方清的尸体不是一件容易的事。”

就在两人说话间隙，一旁的坟墓几乎推平，一个浑身青黑的尸体扒开坟土露了出来。

而在尸体的身上，明显的能看到无数的黑色牙印。

显而易见，这些人都是被咬死的，而咬死他们的就是马天。

一眨眼，数十座坟墓中都爬出来尸体，这些人男女都有，浑身散发着一种恶臭的味道，朝着两人走了过来。

其中一只尸体悄悄出现在顾原的身后，趁着其没有防备，一把抓住他的肩膀。

顿时，顾原的表情痛苦起来，尸体的那只手仿佛拥有巨大的力量，单手差点将顾原提了起来，任凭他怎么挣扎都没有半分松懈。

并且尸体带着顾原朝着他原本的坟墓走去，看上去是想和顾原同归于尽。

这时顾方也看到这惊险的一幕，连忙冲了过来，用尽全身力气猛的朝着尸体撞了过去。

尸体被巨大的冲击力撞倒，手也下意识的松开，顾原这才回到地面，但脸色铁青，刚才那尸体几乎要将自己的肩膀捏碎一样。

“哥，你没事吧？”

顾原摇摇头表示没事，但眼前的场景却让他的心都提了起来。

此刻，数十只浑身青黑色的尸体将两人团团围住。

忽的，咯吱一声响起。

"Yes, these graves have become shorter."

Gu Fang looked around, his face livid, "And the tombs that are closer to us have changed even more."

"It looks like something is coming out."

Gu Yuan's heart was already in his throat. He was different from Gu Fang. He was a real person, but Gu Fang was not. He was just a character in a script.

"There is no way out."

As soon as he finished speaking, he heard Gu Fang next to him shouting "No," and before Gu Yuan could look back, Gu Fang beside him suddenly pulled Gu Yuan forward a few steps.

Only then did Gu Yuan see a livid hand reaching out from the grave closest to Gu Fang and grabbing Gu Fang.

"Are you okay?" Gu Yuan looked down and found blood on Gu Fang's ankle. It was obviously scratched by the same hand just now.

"It's okay." Gu Fang shook his head and said.

Both of them looked extremely ugly, especially Gu Yuan. He had never imagined that such a weird and terrifying thing would happen.

"It seems that it will not be easy to retrieve Fang Qing's body today."

While the two were talking, the tomb next to them was almost flattened, and a body covered in black and blue was uncovered from the tomb soil.

On the body of the corpse, countless black tooth marks can be clearly seen.

Obviously, these people were all bitten to death, and it was Ma Tian who bit them to death.

In the blink of an eye, corpses crawled out of dozens of graves. These people, both male and female, exuded a foul smell and walked towards the two of them.

One of the corpses quietly appeared behind Gu Yuan and grabbed his shoulder while he was off guard.

Suddenly, Gu Yuan's expression became painful, and the hand of the corpse seemed to have great strength. He almost lifted Gu Yuan up with one hand, and no matter how hard he struggled, he did not relax at all.

And the corpse took Gu Yuan towards his original grave, seemingly wanting to die with Gu Yuan.

At this time, Gu Fang also saw this thrilling scene, rushed over quickly, and slammed into the corpse with all his strength.

The corpse was knocked down by the huge impact, and his hands subconsciously let go. Gu Yuan returned to the ground, but his face was ashen, as if the corpse had almost crushed his shoulders.

"Brother, are you okay?"

Gu Yuan shook his head and said it was okay, but the scene in front of him made his heart skip a beat.

At this moment, dozens of green and black corpses surrounded the two of them.

Suddenly, there was a creaking sound.
